[spoiler=Non-Aligned Bloc Expansion Wave?][b]2028 Non-Aligned Bloc Expansion Vote[/b]

It was the 26th of April, 2028. Prime Minister Ko Jong-hyuk sighed as he looked at the large pile of papers on his desk. They were organized in order of importance, with the most important being on top. Like the King, he too had a red dispatch box, only with the coat of arms of the Prime Minister. In bolded letters, the paper on top of the pile was marked: 

"LETTER OF APPLICATION - DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF BRUDENBURG-BRANDENSHIRE"

"The Prime Minister looked surprised. "Chang-ho! Would you help me out with a task of mine?" His aide-de-camp walked into the room. "Sir?" "Have a seat." the Prime Minister responded. What do you know about this Brudenburg-Brandenshire country? You know, besides it being in Western Elseyr and all. What do you know about their natural resources?" Chang-ho pulled out his tablet.

"Running it through the database now, sir." "Sir, it seems that they don't have much access to highly important resources. They have copper and possibly small amounts of other resources, but they are mostly non-essential for Minhokae and Eneas. Minhokae itself is already working out trade deals with other countries, and I suggest that a broader range of resources must be involved in such a decision regarding accession to the NAB."

"Valuable insight, Chang-ho. Based on your analogy, I would suggest that Brudenburg-Brandenshire's application to be denied at this time, correct? Perhaps when the nation becomes more experienced on the international stage, we could send a letter of invitation to join the NAB, but this is just a thought. What is your opinion on this?" "I would completely agree, sir. We need to make absolutely sure that the NAB remains in the best light possible here. With major military blocs like THEP and the EDU, as well as nearby powers such as Daesun possibly monitoring the NAB's statistics, we mustn't allow ourselves to slip up. Even if we aren't a military bloc, we must have an image as perfect as possible internationally."

"Well then, it's settled. Thank you, Chang-ho. I'll call The King and let him know of the situation. Should His Majesty approve, I'll inform Eneas' Head of Government and see if they are on board with it. Chang-ho nodded, bowed his head slightly, and walked out of the room.

[b]Press Briefing[/b]

It was 6:04 PM. During an extended meeting of a Joint Session of Parliament, Prime Minister Ko Jong-hyuk stood up to address the MPs. When he got to the podium, he nodded his head to both sides of parliament, the government and the opposition. "Mr. Speaker, Members of Parliament. Today, I will inform you all of the decision that the government has taken regarding a nation requesting to join the Non-Aligned Bloc. After reviewing Brudenburg-Brandenshire's official request to join the NAB, the request has been denied. We don't seek to offend anyone."

"Brudenburg-Brandenshire lacks the resources that Minhokae and Eneas are in need of at the moment, and at a time like this where the NAB is still quite new, we all need to be sure that we can cooperate economically, which includes the natural resource area. The NAB needs to stand out in its difference from THEP, the EDU, and nearby expansionist countries, like Daesun. We absolutely must have a vast range of natural resources."

"Regarding difference, we stand out due to our peaceful nature, natural resource allocation, and governmental agendas. Of course, the subject on certain expansionist nations is different in some cases, like differing continents that Minhokae and Eneas reside on. Either way, we must preserve the uprightness of our nations and our look on the world stage. We have spoken with His Majesty the King and the Government of Eneas and they agree with this decision. Thank you, and May God bless us all."[/spoiler]
